forwardable_moments.speaker: ALEX
forwardable_moments.text: So, today's news cycle is buzzing with some pretty significant developments in the AI world. The National Law Review just published an article on April 14, 2026, highlighting the risks of AI vendor lock-in as enterprises are rapidly adopting unified multi-model APIs.

forwardable_moments.speaker: JAMIE
forwardable_moments.text: Meanwhile, Google's Task-Based Agentic Search, published on April 13, 2026, is already disrupting SEO strategies. Search Engine Journal points out that it’s changing the landscape of search engines right now, not tomorrow.

forwardable_moments.speaker: RUFUS
forwardable_moments.text: And speaking of new agents, Anthropic’s Mythos Agent, published on April 13, 2026, is causing a stir in the cybersecurity market. Cybercrime Magazine highlights how it's disrupting traditional cyber defense strategies.

forwardable_moments.speaker: RUFUS
forwardable_moments.text: Over 60% of companies here are eyeing AI-driven security this year. That’s a seismic shift.
